title: User Stories — User Stories — New Requirements Chat

sections.title: 1. Document Information & Governance Baseline
sections.body:
**Document Type:** User Stories Specification (Agile Backlog)
**Project Title:** User Stories — New Requirements Chat
**Specification Version:** v2.0
**Document Status:** PENDING APPROVAL
**Authoring Engine:** REFYNE AI Requirement Engineering Pipeline

This specification defines the decomposed, verifiable user stories, acceptance criteria, and requirement traceability matrix for **User Stories — New Requirements Chat**. All stories are grounded strictly in the source requirements.

sections.title: 2. Source Requirement Summary & Scope Baseline
sections.body:
The source specification establishes a centralized operational platform covering comprehensive clinical, diagnostic, pharmaceutical, financial, and administrative capabilities.

**Key Scope Areas Extracted from Source:**
• **REQ-ID-01 (Identity & Access)**: User Registration — *Allow new users to register securely.*
• **REQ-ID-02 (Identity & Access)**: Authentication & Session Management — *Authenticate users and manage secure session tokens.*
• **REQ-ID-03 (Identity & Access)**: Role-Based Access Control — *Enforce granular permissions per user role.*
• **REQ-CORE-01 (Core Operations)**: Primary Entity Creation — *Create and ingest core business records.*
• **REQ-CORE-02 (Core Operations)**: Entity Modification & Updates — *Update existing records with validation.*
• **REQ-CORE-03 (Core Operations)**: Transaction Processing — *Process primary operational transactions.*
• **REQ-CORE-04 (Core Operations)**: Status Tracking & Workflow — *Manage lifecycle states of core entities.*
• **REQ-CORE-05 (Core Operations)**: Entity Archival & Deletion — *Safely soft-delete or archive records.*
• **REQ-NOTIF-01 (Notifications)**: Event-Driven Alerts — *Trigger notifications upon critical state changes.*
• **REQ-REP-01 (Reporting)**: Operational Dashboards — *Render summary metrics and performance charts.*
• **REQ-REP-02 (Reporting)**: Exportable Business Reports — *Generate PDF/CSV reports for operational data.*
• **REQ-REP-03 (Reporting)**: Search & Multi-Filter Queries — *Provide multi-criteria search across records.*
• **REQ-AUD-01 (Audit & Governance)**: Activity & Security Audit Trails — *Log all critical transactions immutably.*
• **REQ-SYS-01 (System Reliability)**: Data Validation & Error Handling — *Validate API payloads and log exceptions.*
• **REQ-SYS-02 (System Reliability)**: Automated Backup & Recovery — *Execute scheduled database backups.*

sections.title: 3. Authorized System Personas & Role Mappings
sections.body:
The system enforces role-based access for the following authorized personas explicitly identified in the source requirements:

• **System Administrator**: User provisioning, System configuration, Security policy enforcement, Audit oversight
• **Operations Specialist**: Executing daily transactions, Status tracking, Operational data processing
• **Compliance Auditor**: Reviewing audit trails, Validating compliance logs, Generating governance reports
• **Customer / End User**: Account profile management, Self-service requests, Viewing transaction history

sections.title: 4. Epic Decomposition & Module Breakdown
sections.body:
The backlog is partitioned into the following functional Epics:

• **Epic: Audit & Compliance** (1 User Stories)
• **Epic: Core Operations** (5 User Stories)
• **Epic: Identity & Access** (3 User Stories)
• **Epic: Notifications** (1 User Stories)
• **Epic: Reporting** (3 User Stories)
• **Epic: System Reliability** (2 User Stories)

sections.title: 6. End-to-End Workflow Coverage
sections.body:
The user stories fully encompass the complete multi-step workflows defined in the source document:

**Primary Entity Lifecycle Workflow:**
`User Authentication → Entity Ingestion → Payload Validation → Transaction Execution → State Transition → Audit Logging → Notification`

sections.body: This matrix provides 100% bidirectional traceability from original source requirements to executable user stories.

sections.title: 8. Dependency-Derived Release & Sprint Slicing
sections.body:
**Release 1: Outpatient Care, Doctor Availability & Core EMR Foundation**
• **Objective:** Establish patient onboarding, front-desk scheduling, OPD queues, vital signs, allergies, and core doctor notes.
• **User Stories:** 

**Release 2: Inpatient (IPD) Lifecycle, Diagnostic Lab & Pharmacy Operations**
• **Objective:** Deploy inpatient admission-to-discharge, bed allocations, transfers, lab ordering/results, and pharmacy stock decrements.
• **User Stories:** 

**Release 3: Financials, Expenses, Hospital Administration & Governance**
• **Objective:** Complete billing reconciliation, insurance claims, expenses, staff management, general procurement, and audit logs.
• **User Stories:** US-ID-01, US-ID-02, US-ID-03, US-CORE-01, US-CORE-02, US-CORE-03, US-CORE-04, US-CORE-05, US-NOTIF-01, US-REP-01, US-REP-02, US-REP-03, US-AUD-01, US-SYS-01, US-SYS-02

sections.title: 9. Technical Dependencies & Cross-Module Constraints
sections.body:
• **Authentication Gate:** User authentication and role-based access control (US-SEC-01) must be established prior to granting role-specific access.
• **Clinical Encounter Binding:** Prescription and lab orders require an active consultation encounter or inpatient admission record.
• **Financial Invoicing:** Inpatient final billing requires completed discharge clearance from the attending doctor.
• **Inventory Deductions:** Medicine dispensing strictly validates on-hand batch quantities before decrementing stock.

sections.title: 10. Open Items & Stakeholder Clarifications
sections.body:
• **Third-Party Payment Gateway Providers:** Identify specific payment gateway vendors (e.g. Stripe, Razorpay) for digital payment processing.
• **External Insurance Clearinghouses:** Determine whether EDI/electronic insurance claim clearinghouse integration is required in subsequent phases.
• **Hardware Barcode Scanners:** Confirm barcode/QR scanner device protocols for pharmacy inventory batch scanning.

--- Page 1 ---
HR Management System 
 
Build a complete HR Management System (HRMS) as a full-stack web and mobile 
application with role-based access for Super Admin, HR/Admin, Manager, Recruiter, 
Employee, and Finance/Payroll users. The system should include **secure authentication, 
role and permission management, employee master data, departments, designations, branches, 
employee onboarding/offboarding, employee profiles, document management, attendance, 
shift and roster management, leave and holiday management, work-from-home/remote-work 
requests, regularization, timesheets, payroll, salary structures, deductions, bonuses, 
reimbursements, payslips, tax/statutory information, recruitment and applicant tracking, job 
postings, candidate pipeline, interviews, offers, joining management, performance 
management, goals/KPIs, appraisals, feedback, training and learning, asset management, 
employee grievances, announcements, notifications, company policies, HR letters/certificates, 
expense management, travel requests, approval workflows, surveys, employee self-service, 
manager self-service, and comprehensive dashboards and reports. Include search, filters, 
sorting, pagination, bulk import/export, Excel/CSV upload, PDF generation, audit logs, 
activity history, configurable workflows, email/SMS/push notifications, reminders, 
calendar integration, and API integrations. The dashboard should provide HR analytics 
such as headcount, attendance, leave utilization, attrition, recruitment status, payroll 
summaries, department statistics, performance, pending approvals, and upcoming events. 
The project should have a modern responsive UI for Web, Android, and iOS, with a 
centralized backend API, relational database, file/document storage, notification service, 
background jobs, logging, monitoring, validation, encryption, backups, and strong security 
including RBAC, JWT/session management, password policies, MFA-ready architecture, 
API authorization, data privacy, audit trails, and secure document access. Define 
complete workflows such as Recruitment → Candidate Selection → Offer → Joining → 
Onboarding → Employee → Attendance/Leave → Payroll → Performance → 
Promotion/Transfer → Offboarding/Exit, with configurable approval chains for HR, 
managers, finance, and admins. Include master-data configuration, organization settings, 
financial/payroll settings, notification templates, workflow configuration, reports, audit logs, 
and system administration. The final system should be production-ready, scalable, API-
driven, well-documented, tested, and include BRD, SRS, database schema/ERD, API 
documentation, RTM, UI/UX specifications, user stories with acceptance criteria, test 
cases, deployment documentation, and complete role-wise functional requirements.
